critical_code_review_comments: analytics.py is well-factored at ~390 LOC; pure-Mongo aggregation pipelines (no Python loops over collections) keep the listing endpoints fast.

Bot regex `bot|crawl|spider|slurp|bing|google|preview` will also match 'preview' substring inside genuine UA strings (Chrome PreviewMode, Safari Tech Preview); acceptable trade-off but consider word-boundary `\b(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|bing|google|preview)\b` if false-positive skipping ever shows up in pageview counts.

providers_list iterates per-user with two aggregate calls each (paid_jobs + paid_orders) + a reviews aggregate — O(3N) calls; fine while provider count is small, but should be refactored to a single $facet/$lookup pipeline if the provider table grows past a few hundred rows.

_ensure_owner_admin uses two @app.on_event('startup') hooks adjacent (one for escrow scheduler, one for owner admin) — both safe and order-independent here, but FastAPI is moving to lifespan context managers; consider consolidating during the next refactor.

Revenue commission math uses payouts/0.9 to derive gross. This is mathematically exact (and matches escrow.py's gross×0.90 release), but a tiny rounding gap (≤$0.02) can show up on individual rows because each row is round()'d to 2dp before summing. Totals reconcile within the assertion tolerance (<$1) used in tests.
Analytics.jsx is self-contained and uses a hand-rolled SVG sparkline (no chart library bloat) — clean.
PageviewPinger correctly debounces by using useLocation()+useRef to avoid double-firing on the same path within a mount; localStorage session id is namespaced under 'lumo_pv_session'.

The orders_history endpoint loads ALL jobs+orders into memory before slicing — fine at current scale (~165 rows seen during testing) but should switch to per-collection $sort+$limit+$skip pipelines once total > ~5k.
Signups endpoint correctly projects out password_hash via {password_hash: 0} and _clean() strips _id — defence in depth verified.

seed_data_creation: Test ingested ~9 pageviews with session_id prefix 'TEST_' and 1 TEST_rev_xxxx cleaning job (provider_id pre-assigned, $100 flat rate); all auto-cleaned via the session-scope teardown fixture and explicit finally-block delete. Final cleanup pass returned 0 stragglers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shadcn/Radix Select components (signups-role, orders-kind, etc.) are NOT native <select>; Playwright's select_option fails on them. Use page.click('[data-testid="signups-role"]') to open the dropdown then page.locator("[role='option']:has-text('Providers')").click() to pick. Verified by intercepting requests and confirming the URL contains role=provider/kind=job. For the revenue fixture flow, the cleaning category is non-physical so mark-delivered accepts an empty {} body without photos; gross→net math is round(pay_rate × 0.90, 2) ⇒ $90 from $100. Don't try to login as julius.a.mason@gmail.com — the row is passwordless. Default route /admin lands on Analytics tab thanks to AdminConsole.jsx's defaultValue='analytics'.
rca of the issue: No defects discovered. The new analytics router, owner-admin bootstrap, PageviewPinger, and AdminConsole tab wiring all align with the acceptance spec; backend math (gross = payouts/0.9, commission = gross × 0.10) is internally consistent and matches escrow.py's release-time multiplier of 0.90. The only minor non-blockers are the bot-regex 'preview' substring match and the per-provider N+1 aggregate pattern noted above.
